name: llvm-ir-highlighter
description: LLVM IR highlighting, type/instruction/library help, cross-file navigation and rename, completion, formatting, and LLVM verification.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Editing features work; external LLVM verification requires workspace trust.

colors.description: Color of basic-block labels in LLVM IR, at their definitions and at branch, switch and phi references.

llvmIR.workspace.enabled.description: Index LLVM IR files for cross-file navigation, completion and safe rename.

llvmIR.workspace.include.description: Workspace-relative glob for LLVM IR files to index.

llvmIR.workspace.exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob excluded from cross-file indexing.

llvmIR.workspace.maxFiles.description: Maximum files to index per workspace folder. Partial indexes cannot be used for external rename.

llvmIR.workspace.maxTotalBytes.description: Maximum total source bytes to index per workspace folder.

llvmIR.workspace.projectRoots.description: Relative subdirectories treated as independent linkage projects, for example hw0 and hw1. Longest matching root wins.

llvmIR.libraryHelp.enabled.description: Show curated C-library and LLVM intrinsic documentation; declarations and target ABI remain authoritative.

llvmIR.diagnostics.enabled.description: Verify open LLVM IR documents using llvm-as in trusted workspaces.

llvmIR.llvmAsPath.description: LLVM assembler executable. Use the LLVM version matching your project.

llvmIR.diagnostics.builtIn.description: Report built-in checks while editing, without LLVM installed: undefined or duplicate names, malformed blocks, dominance, type mismatches, and unused values. Errors that llvm-as also reports on the same line are shown once.

enumDescriptions: Also check every indexed workspace file (requires llvmIR.workspace.enabled).
llvmIR.diagnostics.scope.description: Which files built-in checks cover. Run LLVM IR: Verify Workspace to check every indexed file with llvm-as.

llvmIR.diagnostics.delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing before verification.

llvmIR.diagnostics.timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for llvm-as.

llvmIR.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred types next to SSA definitions, and what pointers refer to when the file determines it.

llvmIR.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter names before call arguments, from the callee's declaration or, for unnamed library declarations, its documentation. Requires llvmIR.inlayHints.enabled.

llvmIR.codeLens.references.description: Show a reference count above functions, globals and named types. Counts span the workspace when indexing is enabled.

llvmIR.labels.highlight.description: Color basic-block labels with the llvmIR.labelForeground theme color and bold their definitions. Default themes color labels like plain text; override the color with workbench.colorCustomizations.

llvmIR.inlayHints.predecessors.description: Show each block's predecessors after its label (preds: %entry, %loop), unless a ; preds comment is already there. Requires llvmIR.inlayHints.enabled.

llvmIR.codeLens.controlFlowGraph.description: Show a Control-flow graph link above each function definition.

llvmIR.semanticHighlighting.enabled.description: Highlight resolved symbols by their semantic kind.
